title: On least periods of a class of arithmetic functions

definitions.name: x2611_15379_G
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15379_G (k a b c : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), f (b + a * (n + i * c))) /
    f ((Finset.range (k + 1)).lcm (fun i => b + a * (n + i * c)))
definitions.notes: Equation (1.1). Statements restrict n to positive naturals. The arbitrary value at n=0 is never used. Finset.lcm takes the lcm of the indexed terms, including repetitions.

definitions.name: x2611_15379_periodFormula
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15379_periodFormula (k a b c : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ) : ℕ := by
  classical
  let d := Nat.gcd a b
  let A := a / d
  let L := Nat.lcmUpto k
  let R : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ := fun p j =>
    f (p ^ (d.factorization p + c.factorization p + j)) /
      f (p ^ (d.factorization p + c.factorization p + j - 1))
  let M : ℕ → ℕ := fun p =>
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (L.factorization p)).filter
      (fun j => (k + 1).factorization p < j ∧ R p j ≠ 1)).sup id
  let K : ℕ → ℂ := fun p =>
    f (p ^ (d.factorization p + c.factorization p)) ^ k *
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (min (L.factorization p) ((k + 1).factorization p)),
        R p j ^ ((k + 1) / p ^ j - 1)
  let e : ℕ → ℕ := fun p =>
    if 0 < M p then c.factorization p + M p
    else ((Finset.range (c.factorization p)).filter
      (fun j => f (p ^ (d.factorization p + j)) ^ k ≠ K p)).sup (fun j => j + 1)
  exact ∏ p ∈ ((c * L).primeFactors.filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ A)), p ^ e p
definitions.notes: Theorem 1.1, with local d,A,L,R,M,K,e exactly as printed. Nat.factorization p is v_p on the positive arguments used here. Finset.sup on naturals returns 0 for the empty set, implementing max(S ∪ {0}). The division and subtraction in the exponent of K are natural-number operations; the printed hypotheses guarantee these exponents are nonnegative integers. K is defined for all p but used only when M p=0. All formula inputs used in statements satisfy k,a,c>0.

definitions.name: x2611_15379_monotonicPeriod
definitions.lean:
def x2611_15379_monotonicPeriod (k a b c : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (∏ p ∈ (c.primeFactors.filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ a / Nat.gcd a b)),
    p ^ c.factorization p) *
  ∏ p ∈ ((Nat.lcmUpto k).primeFactors.filter (fun p =>
    ¬ p ∣ a / Nat.gcd a b ∧
      (k + 1).factorization p < (Nat.lcmUpto k).factorization p)),
    p ^ (Nat.lcmUpto k).factorization p
definitions.notes: The product in Corollary 1.1. A=a/gcd(a,b) and L=Nat.lcmUpto k. Primes appearing in both products contribute both exponents, as printed. It also expresses Theorem A when a=c=1,b=0, including k=0 via empty products.

definitions.name: x2611_15379_N
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15379_N (p j k : ℕ) (u z : ℤ) : ℕ :=
  ((Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) (k : ℤ)).filter
    (fun i => (p : ℤ) ^ j ∣ z + u * i)).card
definitions.notes: Lemma 2.2: N_j(z), with integer indices 0≤i≤k and integer divisibility, including negative z and negative coprime u.

definitions.name: x2611_15379_hongQianPeriod
definitions.lean:
def x2611_15379_hongQianPeriod (k a : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Nat.lcmUpto k /
    (max 1 (((Finset.range (k + 1)).filter (fun p =>
      Nat.Prime p ∧ ¬ p ∣ a ∧
        (Nat.lcmUpto k).factorization p ≤ (k + 1).factorization p)).sup
          (fun p => p ^ (Nat.lcmUpto k).factorization p)) *
      ∏ q ∈ (Nat.gcd a (Nat.lcmUpto k)).primeFactors,
        q ^ (Nat.lcmUpto k).factorization q)
definitions.notes: Theorem B: Q_{k,a}. The max 1 of the finite sup gives δ_{k,a}=1 if the eligible prime set is empty, and p^{e_{p,k}} otherwise. The paper explicitly states that the eligible prime is unique. e_{p,k}=v_p(L_k) for k≥1; k=0 gives the printed empty product convention.

statements.label: Theorem 1.1
statements.name: x2611_15379_thm1_1
statements.original:
Let $G_{f}$ be defined by (1.1). For each prime $p\mid cL$ with $p\nmid A$ , put

 $e_{p}=\begin{cases}v_{p}(c)+M_{p},&M_{p}>0,\\
\max\left(\left\{j+1:0\leq j<v_{p}(c),f\left(p^{v_{p}(d)+j}\right)^{k}\neq K_{p}\right\}\cup\{0\}\right),&M_{p}=0.\end{cases}$ 

Then the least positive period of $G_{f}$ is

 $P_{f}=\prod\limits_{\begin{subarray}{c}p\mid cL\\
p\nmid A\end{subarray}}p^{e_{p}}.$
statements.lean: (k a b c : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℂ) (hf : f.IsMultiplicative) (hnz : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → f n ≠ 0) : IsLeast {T : ℕ | 0 < T ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (x2611_15379_G k a b c f) (n + T) = (x2611_15379_G k a b c f) n} (x2611_15379_periodFormula k a b c f)
statements.notes: All global hypotheses from (1.1) are included: k,a,c positive, b nonnegative, and f nonvanishing and multiplicative on positive integers. ArithmeticFunction supplies an irrelevant canonical value f 0=0. IsLeast specifies both the stated positive period and minimality among every positive period on n≥1. The auxiliary definition expands the printed R,M,K,e formula without alteration.

fidelity.twin: (k a b c : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (hf_one : f 1 = 1) (hf_nonzero : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → f n ≠ 0) (hf_mul : ∀ m n : ℕ, 0 < m → 0 < n → Nat.Coprime m n → f (m * n) = f m * f n) : IsLeast {T : ℕ | 0 < T ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → x2611_15379_G k a b c f (n + T) = x2611_15379_G k a b c f n} (x2611_15379_periodFormula k a b c f)
fidelity.equivalence_proof:
theorem x2611_15379_thm1_1_eqv_aux_G_congr
    (k a b c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (f g : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hfg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → f n = g n) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    x2611_15379_G k a b c f n = x2611_15379_G k a b c g n := by
  have hpos (i : ℕ) : 0 < b + a * (n + i * c) := by positivity
  have hlcm : 0 < (Finset.range (k + 1)).lcm (fun i => b + a * (n + i * c)) := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    exact Finset.lcm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => (hpos i).ne')
  unfold x2611_15379_G
  rw [hfg _ hlcm]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => hfg _ (hpos i))

theorem x2611_15379_thm1_1_eqv_aux_formula_congr
    (k a b c : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hfg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → f n = g n) :
    x2611_15379_periodFormula k a b c f =
      x2611_15379_periodFormula k a b c g := by
  classical
  unfold x2611_15379_periodFormula
  dsimp only
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  have hp0 : 0 < p := Nat.pos_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
  have hpowers (e : ℕ) : f (p ^ e) = g (p ^ e) := hfg _ (pow_pos hp0 e)
  simp only [hpowers]

theorem x2611_15379_thm1_1_eqv :
    (∀ (k a b c : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c)
      (f : ArithmeticFunction ℂ) (hf : f.IsMultiplicative)
      (hnz : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → f n ≠ 0),
      IsLeast {T : ℕ | 0 < T ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
        (x2611_15379_G k a b c f) (n + T) = (x2611_15379_G k a b c f) n}
        (x2611_15379_periodFormula k a b c f)) ↔
    (∀ (k a b c : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c)
      (f : ℕ → ℂ) (hf_one : f 1 = 1)
      (hf_nonzero : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → f n ≠ 0)
      (hf_mul : ∀ m n : ℕ, 0 < m → 0 < n → Nat.Coprime m n →
        f (m * n) = f m * f n),
      IsLeast {T : ℕ | 0 < T ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
        x2611_15379_G k a b c f (n + T) = x2611_15379_G k a b c f n}
        (x2611_15379_periodFormula k a b c f)) := by

  · intro hA k a b c hk ha hc f hf_one hf_nonzero hf_mul
    let g : ArithmeticFunction ℂ := ⟨fun n => if n = 0 then 0 else f n, by simp⟩
    have hg (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : g n = f n := by
      change (if n = 0 then 0 else f n) = f n
      simp only [if_neg hn.ne']
    have hgm : g.IsMultiplicative := by
      constructor
      · rw [hg 1 (by decide)]
        exact hf_one
      · intro m n hmn
        by_cases hm : m = 0
        · subst m
          simp
        by_cases hn : n = 0
        · subst n
          simp
        rw [hg (m * n) (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)),
          hg m (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm), hg n (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)]
        exact hf_mul m n (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) hmn
    have hgnz (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : g n ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hg n hn]
      exact hf_nonzero n hn
    have h := hA k a b c hk ha hc g hgm hgnz
    have hG (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
        x2611_15379_G k a b c g n = x2611_15379_G k a b c f n :=
      x2611_15379_thm1_1_eqv_aux_G_congr k a b c ha g f hg n hn
    have hperiod (T : ℕ) :
        (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → x2611_15379_G k a b c g (n + T) = x2611_15379_G k a b c g n) ↔

        exact H n hn

statements.label: Corollary 1.1
statements.name: x2611_15379_cor1_1
statements.original:
If $f$ is strictly prime-power monotonic, then the least positive period of $G_{f}$ is

 $\prod\limits_{\begin{subarray}{c}p\mid c\\
p\nmid A\end{subarray}}p^{v_{p}(c)}\prod\limits_{\begin{subarray}{c}p\mid L\\
p\nmid A\\
v_{p}(L)>v_{p}(k+1)\end{subarray}}p^{v_{p}(L)}.$

statements.notes: The inherited multiplicativity and parameter hypotheses are retained. Positive-valued f is real-valued and embedded in ℂ in G. Strict prime-power monotonicity means strictly increasing or strictly decreasing for each prime separately, including m=0; the direction may depend on p.
